messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High KV-cache growth detected on prod-cluster-7 (region-us-west-2). Continuous-batching backlog increasing, memory usage rising -> potential OOM. Auto-mitigation attempted: disabled continuous batching on pool-7, but partial flushes observed. PD triggered: P0. https://internal.ops/alerts/2790012345 :rotating_light:
meera (oncall): saw it. looking at trace now. tagging @sre-jamie and @alex (infra).
sre-jamie: joining. initial metric snapshot: kv_cache_size spike from 20GB -> 95GB in ~6m, batch_queue depth +3800, avg token cadence latency jumped x6.
alex (infra): any recent deploys to runtime? I see a canary earlier rolling for "continuous-batch-opt" at 2790012200 but rollout was 40%.
meera (oncall): can we roll that back quickly?
ops-lead: recommend immediate rollback of continuous-batch-opt canary and revert batch_window from 12ms -> 3ms. will coordinate with infra.
sre-jamie: agree. if rollback not immediate, we should hotpatch config to force disable continuous batching per-pool: 
```
# runtime hotpatch
kv_continuous_batch_enabled: false
batch_window_ms: 3
max_prefetch_tokens: 512
```
meera (oncall): applying hotpatch to pool-7 now. patch command: `rctl apply-config --cluster prod-cluster-7 --file /tmp/hotpatch.yaml`
incident-bot: ACTION: hotpatch applied to prod-cluster-7 by meera (oncall) at 2790012478. Auto-rollbacks scheduled if metrics don't stabilize in 5m.
alex (infra): I'm also starting a canary rollback of continuous-batch-opt via deploy-manager, targetting 2 nodes first.
customer-success: heads-up — several high-throughput customers might see slower responses for a short window. drafting a note.
sre-jamie: after hotpatch metrics: kv_cache_size flattened, batch_queue depth starting to drop. token cadence still showing occasional stalls at ~10s intervals. suspect partial flush bug in streaming pipeline.
meera (oncall): logs show repeated partial-flush events: 
```
WARN streaming: partial flush at offset=124857 state=KV_STALE
ERROR kv-cache: failed evict slices: key=abc123 err=out_of_bounds
```
meera (oncall): filing an incident subtask for streaming partial flush investigation.
ops-lead: escalate to runtime-hotswap team — partial flush + continuous batching disabled is mitigating but not fully resolved. we should prepare a customer-facing postmortem outline.
sre-jamie: quick mitigation idea: throttle incoming streaming requests for pool-7 to 60% of normal ingress and enable prefix-cache-offload to disk for cold keys to reduce memory pressure. will run commands now: `rctl set-ingress --cluster prod-cluster-7 --rate 0.6` and `rctl enable-offload --cluster prod-cluster-7`
incident-bot: ACTION: ingress throttling and prefix-offload enabled at 2790012612. Observability: latency p50 back to ~120ms, p95 elevated but trending down.
alex (infra): look at this trace dump — some sessions show a token cadence stall when KV eviction collides with streaming writeback. attaching sample: `s3://internal-dumps/2790012345/trace-7.log`
customer-success: we have two customers (acct-42, acct-99) reporting degraded experience. CS reached out, they accept mitigation for now but want ETA.
meera (oncall): ETA: target stable state <30m, full root-cause + fix may take longer. sharing this to #incidents and to oncall rotation.
sre-jamie: quick root-cause hypothesis: canary for continuous-batch-opt changed how KV prefetch/pinning interacts with streaming partial flush; unpinned entries caused eviction thrash and partial flush race. will reproduce in staging using traffic replay.
ops-lead: escalation to runtime-hotswap team acknowledged. assigning to @alex (infra) and @sre-jamie for hotfix path: 1) revert canary 2) add GC backpressure in kv engine 3) patch partial-flush to checkpoint before eviction.
meera (oncall): adding handoff notes for next on-call: 
- mitigations applied: continuous batching disabled, batch_window reduced, ingress throttled to 60%, prefix-offload enabled
- customer impact: degraded p95 and some token stalls for streaming sessions; two accounts reported issues; no widespread errors returned (mostly latency).
- outstanding: partial-flush race still reproducible under replay. runtime-hotswap working on patch.
incident-bot: HANDOFF: on-call shift change at 2790012900. @meera to @sre-jamie.
sre-jamie: I'll continue. will run a staged canary for the patch in staging and then small prod canary (1 node) after validation. timeline ~3-6h for patch + rollout.
customer-success: ping if we need an official customer message. draft for review: "We're investigating transient streaming latency and partial token stalls tied to KV caching behavior. We've applied mitigations and expect reduced impact within 30 minutes. Full fix being rolled out; we'll follow up with a postmortem."
alex (infra): leaving a quick debugging snippet for follow-up: 
```
# reproduce locally (traffic replay)
replay-tool --trace s3://internal-dumps/2790012345/trace-7.log --rate 2x --target staging-cluster
```
meera (oncall): last check before handoff: memory usage stable at ~28GB, batch_queue depth down to normal, token cadence gaps less frequent. handing off.
sre-jamie: taking over. will update thread with canary results. thanks all. :thumbsup:
